title: MalPDF-EFS: Enhanced Feature Set Dataset for Malicious PDF Detection (Benign, Old, and Recent Malicious Samples)
description:
MalPDF-EFS is a sample of the feature data used in: D.-S. Choi, T. Kim, B. Kang, and E. G. Im, "Machine learning-based detection method for malicious PDF files: A temporal classification approach," Applied Soft Computing, vol. 189, Art. no. 114461, Mar. 2026, available online 23 Dec. 2025 (https://doi.org/10.1016/j.asoc.2025.114461).

In the paper, malicious PDF files were collected from public malware repositories and the Contagio dataset, and grouped by creation date into old (created before 2020) and recent (created in 2020-2024) malicious PDF files. After comparing the groups, 12 new features were added to the basic feature set of 31 features, giving an enhanced feature set of 43 features.

This dataset contains 1,000 randomly sampled PDF files for each of three groups (benign, old malicious, recent malicious), 3,000 in total, as two feature sets: FS31 (basic feature set) and FS43 (enhanced feature set). It is a sample of the experimental data, not the full dataset. Only extracted features are included; PDF files, file names, and file hashes are not.

If you find this dataset useful in your research, please consider citing the article above.
